trap.label: by + diferença
trap.wrong: Inflation has increased in 2 points since May.
trap.right: Inflation has increased by 2 points since May.
trap.why: Em português “subiu em 2 pontos” usa em. Em inglês, a diferença numérica usa by; in aparece em “in May”.

mcq.q: “Not so much a crisis as a test of nerve” stresses...

fix.wrong: Core inflation remained steady, however headline eased.
fix.right: Core inflation remained steady; however, headline eased.

fix.wrong: The shock was increase by 5 points.
fix.right: The shock was an increase of 5 points.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com yet: “Headline eased, but core did not.” (…, yet…)
rewrite.answer: Headline eased, yet core did not.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com not so much…as: “It was a test of nerve, rather than a crisis.”
rewrite.answer: It was not so much a crisis as a test of nerve.
